name: The Upper House
insider_take: Sky-high sanctuary floating above the urban energy of Admiralty, where minimalist Zen meets cosmopolitan sophistication.
whats_special: This boutique gem occupies floors 38-49 of Pacific Place, making it one of Hong Kong's highest hotels. The property features no traditional lobby - instead, guests are whisked directly to Sky Lounge on the 49th floor. Each room boasts floor-to-ceiling windows with sweeping harbor or mountain views, while the hotel's signature green tea scent creates an instantly recognizable sensory experience.
pro_tip: Book a Studio 70 room on floors 45-47 for the most dramatic Victoria Harbour views, especially stunning during the Symphony of Lights show at 8pm nightly.
dont_miss: The infinity-edge outdoor terrace on the 49th floor offers unobstructed 270-degree city views. Connected directly to Pacific Place mall, you're steps from luxury shopping and the historic Hong Kong Park with its famous Edward Youde Aviary. The nearby Admiralty MTR station provides seamless access to Central's financial district and Tsim Sha Tsui's cultural attractions.
pros: Exceptional contemporary design with minimalist luxury aesthetic
Prime location in Admiralty with easy access to business and shopping districts
Personalized service with high staff-to-guest ratio
Spacious rooms and suites with floor-to-ceiling windows offering stunning city views
cons: Limited dining options within the hotel
